blocks.text: Agents that manage your local workspaces

inlines.text: Agents that manage your local workspaces

blocks.text: Agents in local workspaces can now start and manage other agents. Ask Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode to create a workspace for a task, start a chat with another agent, wait for its reply, and send follow-ups. Agents can also cancel and archive chats and workspaces, set workspace statuses, organize workspaces into sidebar sections, and update a repository's setup, run, and archive scripts.

Improvements
Conductor now runs on Electron instead of Tauri, which makes the app faster and more stable, and helps us find and fix issues sooner.
Highlight text in a chat and click Add to chat, or press ⌘L, to quote it in your next message.
Open as many chat, terminal, and browser tabs as you like in a workspace.
In local repository settings, you can set the run mode, mark an action as the default, choose where an action can run, and turn on enterprise data privacy for a single repository.
When the sidebar is grouped by status, drag a workspace onto Backlog, In progress, In review, or Done to change its status.
Each sidebar section's menu has its own Group by, Filter by project, and Sort by options.
Create a new section from the section menu next to the Create button. New workspaces default to the section you last created a workspace in.
Chat checkpoints are faster to create in large repositories, so agents start editing files sooner.
Admins of cloud organizations can set a custom icon for each repository in Settings → Repositories → Git.
In cloud workspaces, the sidebar shows each workspace's repo icon next to its status again when your cloud computer has more than one repo.
Fixes
Fixed archiving or restoring a workspace running shell code embedded in its branch name.
Fixed new workspaces sometimes getting stuck on "Running setup script…" when the setup script finished instantly.
Fixed Clear & unarchive sometimes leaving a restored workspace with an empty folder.
Fixed diffs showing a light background in dark mode when your system appearance is set to light.
Fixed answering a question with the text "USER_CANCELLED" cancelling it.
Fixed queued Cursor and OpenCode chats showing a Claude Code download status.
Fixed an extra blank line at the end of some sent messages, such as the merge conflict prompt.
Fixed the Checks summary in the Git panel showing cancelled checks as passed.
Fixed the All Workspaces list sometimes stopping loading more workspaces as you scroll.
Fixed the Dashboard briefly showing its empty state while workspaces were loading.
Fixed a cancelling chat showing the unread dot instead of the cancelling indicator.
Fixed keyboard focus being lost after picking a model from search in the model picker.
Fixed searching in Move to section sometimes picking the wrong section.
Fixed file badges opening, copying, or downloading the wrong file for names starting with
Fixed a disabled MCP server showing as needing authentication in the MCP status popover.
Fixed the "Add repository" button in the repo picker scrolling out of view when you have many repos.
A PR title or description that fails to save now shows an error and keeps your edit.
Fixed reopening a chat in the iOS app while remote controlling your Mac sometimes resending old messages or failing with "Internal error".
With remote control on, a plugged-in Mac now stays awake even when no phone is connected, so your phone can still reach it.
Fixed repositories with SSH certificate remotes, like
org-…@github.com
, not being recognized as GitHub repositories.
In cloud workspaces, fixed the status showing "Running" while the setup script was still running, and the terminal header showing "Running in cloud" while disconnected.
Fixed cloud workspace repo icons in the sidebar changing after you click a workspace.
Misc
Conductor now stores settings in the app instead of
.conductor/settings.toml
files. Your existing settings are imported automatically.
Removed the experimental Sidebar transparency, Use legacy file preview and editing, Auto-run after setup, and Tab Freak Mode settings.
